subject: Obelisk security onboarding and kickoff — Q&A & milestones
messages:
From: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
To: Alex Martin <alex.martin@obeliskinsurance.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Obelisk security onboarding and kickoff — Q&A & milestones

Hi Alex —

Thanks for choosing Redwood for the proof-of-concept — excited to get the security onboarding started. To make the intake call efficient, propose a 30–45 minute kickoff where we:

- walk through the SIG/CAIQ sections you care most about (control priorities)
- confirm evidence owners and collection windows
- agree on a delivery milestone for initial artifacts

Proposed times (PST): Wed 11/25 10:00–10:45, Wed 11/25 14:00–14:45, Thu 11/26 09:00–09:45. Please pick a slot or tell me alternatives.

Attached: Redwood-SIG-Intake-Template.xlsx (we prefilled the sections we usually collect) and a short security-factsheet.pdf. If you already have a SIG or CAIQ document, send it along and we will map the overlap.

Pre-call asks:
- Who from Obelisk will own evidence (names + emails)?
- Any compliance deadlines we should know about (e.g., procurement cutoffs, audit windows)?
- Are there specific log retention samples or architectures to review?

CCing Marissa (security intake) — she will join the call and capture the action items.

Thanks,
Logan Wright
Enterprise Sales — Redwood Inference
logan_wright@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0198

From: Alex Martin <alex.martin@obeliskinsurance.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Procurement Team <procure@obeliskinsurance.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Obelisk security onboarding and kickoff — Q&A & milestones

Logan — thanks for the quick note. Wed 11/25 14:00 PST works for our side. Attendees:
- Alex Martin (Security Lead)
- Priya Rao (Cloud Engineering)
- Procurement Team (procure@obeliskinsurance.com) — they need a milestone for contract review

We have a partially completed CAIQ and some architecture diagrams — attaching a short list of what we expect to prioritize (Obelisk-Initial-Questions.docx). Priority areas: data residency, audit logs retention (we keep logs 13 months), and key management (we use AWS KMS). A couple of quick Qs before the call:

1) Can Redwood provide an example of the access logs you capture for inference requests (metadata only — no customer data)?
2) Do you have a preferred format for redaction evidence when customers request it?

We'll share the CAIQ export before the meeting. Procurement is asking for a milestone target: they would like an initial evidence packet within 10 business days of the kickoff. Is that feasible?

Alex
Alex Martin | Security Lead, Obelisk Insurance
alex.martin@obeliskinsurance.com | +1 (312) 555-0133

From: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
To: Alex Martin <alex.martin@obeliskinsurance.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 11:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Obelisk security onboarding and kickoff — Q&A & milestones

Perfect — locking 11/25 14:00 PST. Zoom link: https://zoom.us/j/9876543210

Short answers pre-call:
- Access logs: yes, we can provide request-level metadata (timestamp, model, token counts, request latency, routing region). We do not include customer prompt/response content in log exports by default; we can produce a redacted sample.
- Redaction evidence: we typically provide an artifacts package (CSV manifest + redaction rules) and samples in the same format as our log exports. We will bring the template to the call.
- Initial evidence packet in 10 business days: feasible for the CAIQ sections that map to our standard artifacts (auth, network, key management, logging). Anything requiring customer-controlled configuration (e.g., VPC peering proof) may require coordination on your side.

Agenda for the call (30–45 min):
1) Introductions + scope (5 min)
2) Walk CAIQ/priority controls (10–15 min)
3) Evidence owners & handoff plan (10 min)
4) Milestone agreement & next steps (5–10 min)

Marissa will take notes and assign evidence owners during the call. Dylan (security ops) will own the log/export samples — he may follow up after the meeting for access details.

See you Wednesday — attaching the intake template again.

Thanks,
Logan
Enterprise Sales — Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Martin <alex.martin@obeliskinsurance.com>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>, Procurement Team <procure@obeliskinsurance.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 08:43:00 -0800
Subject: Follow-up: Obelisk security onboarding — notes & action items

Thanks again for the kickoff today — notes and agreed actions below.

Meeting notes (summary):
- Scope confirmed: CAIQ intake with priority on logging, key management, data residency controls.
- Evidence timeline: initial packet due by 2026-12-09 (10 business days from 11/25) for the mapped CAIQ domains. Procurement will use this for contract review.
- Log export sample: Redwood to provide a redacted request-metadata sample (no prompt/response), plus a CSV manifest describing fields. Owner: Dylan Brooks (dylan_brooks@redwood.com). Deliverable: redacted-sample.csv, due 2026-12-02.
- Evidence owner matrix: Redwood to populate the intake template with artifact locations and owners. Owner: Marissa Cole. Deliverable: evidence-owner-matrix.csv, due 2026-12-09.
- VPC/Network proofs: If Obelisk requires on-prem/VPC-specific artifacts, Obelisk engineering (Priya Rao) will provide access details and expected artifact types; may extend the timeline.

Action items:
- Dylan: produce redacted log export sample and CSV manifest — due 2026-12-02.
- Marissa: populate and return completed intake template (evidence-owner-matrix.csv) — due 2026-12-09.
- Alex/Priya: share your CAIQ export and any network diagrams — please attach to the Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-Obelisk-Onboarding by EOD 11/26.
- Procurement: confirm milestone acceptance for contract review (Procurement Team).

Attachments referenced: Redwood-SIG-Intake-Template.xlsx (populated), evidence-owner-matrix.csv (draft).

If anything above needs correction, reply-all and we'll update.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Security Intake Lead — Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com | +1 (650) 555-0120
